Chapter 999: Mysterious Youth

Chapter 999: Mysterious Youth

Li Qiye recalled the silver arrow. With a pop, the Storm God’s body fell to the ground while the entire city was muted!

He sat on the imperial throne and glanced at the crowd then the entire city before slowly uttering: “Anyone else is dissatisfied or have some comments to say about me?”

One could hear the drop of a needle in the city right now. Many people held their breath; even the Blood ancestors didn’t dare to say a single word.

“Very good.” Li Qiye stood up and calmly said: “If anyone has grudges against me or find that I am unpleasing to the eyes, both one on one or a group fight are fine, I will gladly accept the challenge. However, if they involve the people around me with their feud, then wait for a sect-destruction disaster!”

“Tell the Blood-devil Tribe. I am a merciful person and will give them one day of preparation. I will personally come after one day and destroy their sects and ancestral grounds. This is the result of those who maneuver against my people.” His voice was not loud yet everyone in the city heard him clearly.

In the past, someone would have mocked Li Qiye. The Blood Race was the noon sun in present time with geniuses appearing one after another, especially within the Blood-devil Tribe. Their solidarity was unrivaled. No one would dare to oppose them, let alone talking about stomping their lineages!

But today, Li Qiye dared to utter such words but the Blood-devil ancestors here didn’t have the guts to retort! He was not afraid of an emperor’s sentiment; just how heaven-defying was he!?

“Boom!” Eventually, Li QIye opened the imperial decree and casually threw it to the ground like a piece of trash.

Yi Chuan was quite smart; he noticed and quickly picked it up. Even though this imperial decree no longer had any power, it was still a great treasure to a small country like Suhuang.

“Young Noble Li…” The Thunder Tower Lord who was trapped in the tower quickly bowed after seeing Li Qiye and apologized: “It is my Crimson Night’s fault for all this to happen, please forgive us.”

Li Qiye sat on the throne and looked at the tower lord. He gently shook his head: “To tell the truth, I’m very disappointed. Someone of your realm can’t even take out an imperial weapon, it is quite embarrassing for an ancestor.”

Such words left the tower lord feeling awkward. He didn’t know how to respond and could only smile wryly: “Well… the Storm God had full control of the kingdom. Old geezers like us had our hands tied.

The imperial princess naturally had full sovereignty over the kingdom. Even stronger ancestors compared to her were still suppressed!

The tower lord quickly apologized once more: “This time I and several other ancestors were discussing how to settle this problem but we didn’t expect for the Storm God’s first branch to be so aggressive. They dismissed several ancestors preemptively. Our kingdom absolutely does not wish to oppose Young Noble Li.”

“Unfortunately, it is a little late. Right now, I am planning on visiting your kingdom. Without a baptism of blood, a few people will never understand my merciless means.” Li Qiye said dismissively.

This scared the soul out of the tower lord. He quickly prostrated to the ground: “Young noble, please give my kingdom a chance. I promise that we will definitely remove the Storm God’s first branch from the kingdom’s order. I guarantee it with my life. Yuanyuan will become the Crimson Night Royal Lord and we shall plead loyalty to you!”

The tower lord knew Li Qiye had obtained the legacy of the Blood Progenitor and will definitely ruler the Blood Race in the future. Without showing him their strong commitment right now, their future seemed quite grim.

“Please give us another chance!” The tower lord’s head met the ground. Even an ancestor of his level could only ask Li Qiye for forgiveness.

Li Qiye glanced at the tower lord then Si Yuanyuan. At this moment, she didn’t dare to intercede. She knew that his decision was not something she could influence.

“Fine, I will give your kingdom another chance.” After a while, he slowly spoke: “If you still can’t fix this problem, then I’ll do it myself then. You should understand that my personal visit will not end before seeing blood.”

“Rest assured, young noble, it will go as you wish this time.” The kneeling tower lord solemnly promised: “Once Yuanyuan is in control, our kingdom will obey all your orders!”

Li Qiye gently nodded then told Si Yuanyuan: “I have taught everything to you that should be taught. Your next path is up to you; whether you can become an amazing ruler or not depends on your own effort. None of my proteges turned out to be weak, do not disappoint me.”

Si Yuanyuan kneeled on the ground and quietly bowed her head towards Li Qiye. All she had today was given to her by Li Qiye. She was an exiled disciple from the kingdom. To be able to return was already too great of a wish. She never thought she would be able to rule the country one day.

His declaration and feats spread overnight to the entire Barren Earth. Countless humans became excited. The young humans had been far too quiet in this region and finally, one prodigy has risen. Perhaps he will be able to lead the humans to newfound glory.

“A second Lin Tiandi!” Someone commented with emotions after hearing his legends.

“No, even more heaven-defying than Lin Tiandi!” Someone else murmured: “Just climbing the Prime Peak alone is matchless. Lin Tiandi, no matter how great he is, couldn’t do it either.”

In a southern desolate area, a young man was traveling across the world in a transcending and mysterious manner. The myriad dao accompanied his steps as if he was the ruler of the dao. He was referred to as the number one genius of the Barren Earth – Lin Tiandi.

“Amazing, such accomplishments, even the most era-defying geniuses would have to chase him from behind.” Lin Tiandi was in awe after hearing the news and became absent-minded for a moment. He finally regained his senses and smiled: “This generation will not be boring, it shall be a brilliant one. Otherwise, with just the group of Jikong Wudi, how could they compete against my senior brother.”

With that, he continued on forward with the same carefree and unrestrained attitude as before. It seemed that nothing could him back from having peace of mind.

***

Mysterious Bamboo Mountain, one of the most powerful lineages in the Barren Earth, was on the same level as Heavenguard. It was a sect with three emperors. Among them, one was a demon, another was a golem, and the last was said to be either a demon or a dragon.

Many demon tribes considered Mysterious Bamboo to be their leader and followed its order. However, after Immortal Emperor Yin Tian, Mysterious Bamboo maintained a very low-profile and became strangely isolated.

There was an ancient pavilion in Mysterious Bamboo with a young man lying there. Even his casual pose left others with a heaven-devouring feeling. To describe him as being among the heavens was not an exaggeration at all.

This youth seemed to just be waking up. The door opened, an ancestor came in and reported the news of the Barren earth to him.

“A Silver arrow!” The youth immediately sat up after hearing this. Even the nine heavens shook his shift. A flash emerged in his eyes like the illumination of three thousand worlds. It was extremely terrifying. Even Godkings standing before him would quake with fear. This youth was absolutely mighty beyond imagination!

“Are you positive that it was a silver arrow!?” The youth asked again. He had a hard time believing this.

“Honorable ancestor, I’m completely sure.” This Mysterious Bamboo ancestor was very reverent towards this youth.

“Is it, can it be…” The youth’s expression shifted and was lost in a daze as he murmured.

The moment this youth calmed down, he quickly disappeared. In this blink of an eye, he crossed time and space. Each of his steps traveled through countless locations. If one could see his method, they would be jolted. Just a few steps of his were able to cross an entire area. This was too heaven-defying!

When the night curtain fell, the youth appeared right outside of the Holy City. No one knew that he has arrived. He stood in the sky, untraceable as if he was one with the heaven and earth. Not to mention God-Monarchs, not even Godkings would be able to detect him.

He opened his eyes, revealing a glare capable of crossing the eons back into the past. It eventually fell upon the Thunder Tower.

Inside the tower, Li Qiye was sitting down and meditating quietly. When the youth’s stare reached the Thunder Tower, Li Qiye suddenly opened his eyes to look at the youth’s position. Afterward, he closed his eyes again and reached a zen state once more.

“Thump, thump, thump!” The youth took several steps back in shock. He left without saying another word and returned to Mysterious Bamboo in an instant.

“Damn, how am I going to live now!?” The youth pulled his own hair with great distressed.

The ancestors here became dumbfounded to see the youth acting like this. They glanced at each other in confusion and didn’t know what had happened.

“Ancestor, what happened?” One of them quietly asked.

“I want to commit suicide, suicide, do you understand!?” The youth jumped up. His handsome face became sour like a bitter melon: “Go, go now, to the town down the mountain. Buy me ten thousand pieces of tofu so that I can kill myself by ramming my head against them!” 1

The ancestors here didn’t know how to respond to this young man.

The youth sat down in his chair with a dejected expression and very reluctantly spoke: “I finally climbed out of the ground and wanted to act cool for a bit, kill some monsters, claim some Heaven’s Will, but now, I have completely wasted my time!”

1. Chinese joke to describe a helpless situation/feeling
